Definition: from G4862 and G2578; to bend together, i.e. (figuratively) to afflict:--bow down.
BiblicalUsage: Paul quotes the psalm over unbelieving Israel: let their eyes be darkened that they may not see, and bow down their back always. The bowing is the judgment of a people who would not bow in worship, and the back that would not bend to God is bent under the burden instead.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that refusing to bow to God ends in being bowed down, and I hold that the only safe bowing is the one I choose in worship.
